title: Question 30
passage:
What do I owe you for the postcards?
A. Nothing. I picked them up for free. B. I put them in your top drawer. C. You can write on either side.
passageZh:
這些明信片我該付你多少錢？
A. 不用。我是免費拿到的。 B. 我把它們放進你最上面的抽屜。 C. 你想寫哪一面都可以。
